hooks.name: Spec drift review after a task
hooks.description: After Kiro finishes a spec task, compare the spec with the code so requirements, design and tasks never fall behind what ships.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Compare .kiro/specs/*/requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md with the code you changed. List any behaviour the code now has that no requirement states, any requirement the code no longer meets, and any task ticked without a test that proves it. Fix the spec where the code is right, and report anything where the code is wrong instead of hiding it.
